svg.title: Detailed KeypointDominantFusionNet architecture
svg.desc: Code-grounded CVPR-style block diagram for KeypointDominantFusionNet showing visible and infrared encoders, content cue extraction, three DominanceCrossAttention modules, decoder, prediction heads, luminance fusion, and auxiliary outputs.
svg.text: Code-grounded diagram for VIS-IR fusion with content cues, three-scale dominance cross-attention, and luminance/color reconstruction
Parallel VIS / IR encoders with DominanceCrossAttention
vf += sigmoid(alpha_vis) * (w_cross*p_i + w_shared*0.5*(p_i+p_v)); IR mirrors VIS
Base width: b=32 by default. ConvBNAct = Conv2d + BatchNorm2d + GELU. Encoders are parallel and updated after each scale by DominanceCrossAttention.
The dominance cue is hand-crafted from brightness, gradient magnitude, and local contrast, then Gaussian-smoothed before being resized for ca1, ca2, and ca3.
The final output mixes a learned RGB prediction with a luminance-preserving VIS color reconstruction controlled by learned scalar pred_mix and spatial IR weight ir_w.
